findings.text: The record's after_suite revision is 77961a75c and logs/suite-rerun-slurm.out line 1 prints HEAD_SHA=77961a75c0ea29b2d60fb9d6378d01f3e04618a2, so the head arm ran before dc97e6f4f changed nova/equilibrium/forward.py; the checkpoint at line 9 nevertheless reads as if both arms completed for the repair round. Every suite file that imports forward was exercised at a revision that does not carry the new field and key element, so the arm cannot show the repair broke no importer. The focused gate covers the touched modules, so this is not a landing blocker, but the wave's merged-head integration run should carry the repaired head.
findings.title: after_suite was measured before the repair it is cited for

findings.text: The sentence states that two geometries in one bucket key identically "which is why the second geometry costs no compilation". The COMPILE rows in logs/operator_bank_h200.log count jit_cache_size and cache_entries of the jitted bank_program, not ForwardProfile._request_compilation_cache, so the measured zero recompilation comes from the program's own shape-static jit; the profile compile key was not on that path. The causal link is unmeasured, and a reader takes it as recorded evidence.
findings.title: the zero-compilation result is attributed to a key the measurement never exercised

findings.text: support_bank defaults to None and git grep at the head finds no construction of a ForwardProfile carrying one outside tests/test_operator_bank_compile.py:96, so _request_compilation_cache_key returns a bucket of None for every request a route can make today. The seam is declared and settable, which is what the prior finding required and what section 1 fences; the wiring is section 4's, and until it lands the key's second element carries no bucket in production.
findings.title: the new bucket slot is None on every production solve

findings.text: dataclasses.replace(profile, operator=operator) passes every init field through, so an attached support_bank survives a replacement of the operator and its grid; a bank's padded rows and its bucket are built for one mesh, so the copied profile would key a bucket that no longer describes its operands. Unreachable while nothing attaches a bank, but the field added at nova/equilibrium/forward.py:574 makes this call site the one that must decide what happens to it when section 4 attaches one.
findings.title: a profile copied with a substituted operator would keep a bank built for the old one

item_verdicts.goal: The node's goal is a per-machine operator bank at fixed shape compiled once; forward.py:574 adds the declared ForwardProfile.support_bank field and forward.py:2775 keys the single compilation cache on its static bucket, which answers the prior review's blocking finding that the slot read an attribute nothing set.
